# Doom Pi Domain

Domain selection and resource staging for Doom Pi sessions.

## How to author

- [Author DoomPi domains](./src/prompts/doompi-author-domain/SKILL.md): Routing and safeguards for editing domain configuration.
- [`domains.yaml` authoring contract](./src/prompts/doompi-author-domain/references/domains-contract.md): Schemas, source forms, layering, filtering, pinning, and verification.

## Package reference

- [Package README](./README.md): The `/domains` command, voice tools, and what a domain switch stages.
